title: cuscuta planiflora var. abyssinica
intro: Cuscuta planiflora var. abyssinica, commonly known as a parasitic plant species, is a type of flowering plant in the dodder family Convolvulaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in Ethiopian folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin infections, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cuscuta planiflora var. abyssinica include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight infections, and exhibit analgesic and antipyretic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
